title: Power Under Control: Food, Sex & Self-Mastery
body:
IUIC in the ClassRoom · 2026-02-28

Opens [2 Pet 3](/bible/2-peter/3) · [Gen 1](/bible/genesis/1) · [Luke 21](/bible/luke/21) · [Phil 3](/bible/philippians/3) · [1 Cor 6](/bible/1-corinthians/6) · [Sir 21](/bible/sirach/21) · [1 Pet 2](/bible/1-peter/2) · [Matt 15](/bible/matthew/15) · [1 Pet 5](/bible/1-peter/5) · [Gal 5](/bible/galatians/5) · [John 4](/bible/john/4)
## Introduction *[[6:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=411s)]* Power under control: food, sex, and self-mastery. On the morning America and Israel struck Iran, Captain Joel teaches that we cannot control the politics or the world leaders, but the Lord gave us control over our own vessel. Genesis 1 gives sex for procreation and food for nourishment side by side, and neither is evil until it is overindulged. Surfeiting overcharges the heart, the belly becomes a god, and the same dopamine reward fires whether it is a Big Mac, a Popeyes biscuit, or an Instagram model, so food porn and pornography are one battle. Satan nurtures the five senses as tunnels into the vessel, sets the stage, and needs a series of yeses; the brain is a computer whose algorithm can be recoded through the holy spirit of discipline, a covenant with the eyes, and the three-second rule, until, like Christ, our meat is to do the will of him that sent us. ## In The News - *[[8:37](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=517s)]* **The class thumbnail, Power Under Control: Food, Sex & Self-Mastery, with the AI image.** — This is not a diet or nutrition class; it is a spiritual nutrition class. All praise for the thumbnail and AV teams working behind the scenes. - *[[18:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=1100s)]* **The definition of surfeiting: excess, an excessive amount, an uncomfortably full or crapulous feeling from excessive eating or drinking.** — To overindulge and go beyond your limits of discipline, whether food, drink, or sex. - *[[42:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=2533s)]* **Pictures of Serena Williams, then a nutrition label of her mental ingredients.** — Brothers like the thick, voluptuous shape, and Hollywood flashes that angle before your eyes on purpose. But she was a fit athlete who altered herself to appeal to society. Read the label on the back: daily drain from rumination, self-hate, low self-esteem, identity confusion, fear of rejection, and people pleasing; self-confidence zero; ingredients of unresolved trauma and social media comparison. Not nourishing to a marriage. - *[[47:23](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=2843s)]* **Instagram and TikTok models.** — It looks appealing, but men do not marry women like this; in her unrepented stage she cannot raise children, be a pillar of rest, or teach her daughters. Esau keeps moving the goalpost from Buffie the Body to bodies altered to balance a table on; lust pushes a woman past her bodily limits to please you. - *[[50:42](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=3042s)]* **McDonald's food and the Big Mac ingredient list.** — The presentation and the smell pushed onto the highway are advertising triggers; the big arch and the big butt are the same tunnel into your senses. Sex sells and food sells. A burger should be meat and bread; this has over fifty ingredients, 1,300 to 1,600 calories in one meal, and chemicals that keep you eating. - *[[53:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=3186s)]* **The Burger King Whopper and its ingredients.** — Master psychologists with the melted cheese and pickles on display. In Japan the same McDonald's burger was real food with simple ingredients; back here it tastes like cardboard. That is the deception of Babylon, and why America is the fattest country in the world. - *[[54:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=3284s)]* **Fried chicken, the buttermilk biscuit, and the Popeyes spicy chicken sandwich with its ingredient list.** — The right nostril flares driving past it, and a biscuit soaked in butter is 600 calories. Brothers lined up around the block for the sandwich and somebody was killed over chicken. Esau studies our bodies, the dopamine and reward vectors each chemical fires, and knows exactly what to put in the food; it is a power struggle over your senses, and Popeyes, Burger King, and McDonald's sit in black neighborhoods. - *[[58:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=3484s)]* **Chick-fil-A, and a man in a Chick-fil-A throwing away a 55-ingredient sandwich.** — It is a Christian company closed on Sundays, so surely it will not poison you; the devil is a liar and an angel of light. God did not make your body to ingest constant chemicals. Go back to real food: meat, fish, vegetables, fruit, whole grains. - *[[1:05:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=3922s)]* **Plates of vegetables, fruit, and blueberries with their nutritional values.** — Nobody salivated; it did not cater to the flesh. Nobody lusts after avocado. But it is beautiful in its natural colors, hits every nutritional value, and is the earthly elements we were made from. Retrain your mind for what really looks and tastes good. - *[[1:08:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=4104s)]* **Daughters of Sarah in modest dress, and a nutrition label for an Israelite woman: quiet and submissive, supportive, respectful, humble, kind, wise, modest, shamefaced, virtuous, caring, diligent, a teacher of good things.** — 1 Timothy 2:9. As with food, you need the nourishing woman, not the one that caters to lust; she encourages you, teaches the children, and speaks scripture. Tobias said, I take not my sister for lust. This is the real excitement, brothers. - *[[1:12:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=4335s)]* **A preacher on our culture's unhealthy relationship with food: we look to food for affirmation, to feel good and safe, and if you cannot control it, it is quite literally sin; you cannot flee from something in your refrigerator.** — People go after sex for the same comfort and affirmation. If you are overweight you are in gluttony, and the brain fires the same reward vectors for the food as for sex; it does not distinguish the two. - *[[1:16:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=4617s)]* **A medical program on how food porn affects the brain: pictures of greasy, sugary food activate the pleasure and reward centers with dopamine, supernormal stimuli, and the advice to pick healthier food porn like strawberries and dark chocolate.** — Food is pornography to the brain, one nourishing the flesh and the other the marriage. You can have the same pleasure the healthy way, with healthy food and with your wife. - *[[1:30:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=5449s)]* **A neuroscientist admitting he loves the smell and taste of donuts and occasionally caves walking past the shop.** — Goals far in the future feel less rewarding than the donut now. The eyes, ears, taste, and smell are windows to the vessel that Satan uses as tunnels. - *[[1:31:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=5490s)]* **Al Pacino's speech from The Devil's Advocate: God gives man instincts and sets the rules in opposition, look but don't touch, touch but don't taste, taste but don't swallow; I have nurtured every sensation man has been inspired to have, I am a humanist.** — One sense leads to the next: the eye signals the hand, the hand the tongue. That is the ladder to fornication. Satan's job is to nurture every sensation; God's job is to discipline the senses through his commandments. - *[[1:38:40](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=5920s)]* **A Medium article: your brain is running an algorithm, learn how to change it. Inputs through the senses, outputs in feelings and actions, working memory and long-term memory as RAM and hard drive, the central nervous system as the processor, and thought patterns as code that can be edited.** — Esau, wiser than Daniel, built the computer after the brain, then built TikTok and Instagram to hook the brain's own algorithm, which is why none of us can put the phone down. The elites program the schools, politics, and TV as one operating system. Christ is the only one who hacked the system and broke the code, wiping out the virus called sin. - *[[1:50:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=6620s)]* **The three-second rule for porn addicts: you cannot control the thoughts that pop into your mind, but you can turn away within three seconds and hand the thought to your higher power.** — Stay on it past three seconds and it enters working memory; keep looking and it becomes long-term. TikTok videos have three seconds to capture you because the algorithm is built on how the brain internalizes information. - *[[1:52:25](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=6745s)]* **Stanford research on social media: intermittent likes are more engaging than consistent rewards, like a slot machine; the algorithm learns what makes you angry, scared, or excited and feeds it back in filter bubbles.** — Your searches and scrolls are a digital footprint that tells anyone who you are, what music you play when angry, and what you like. The algorithm is not them getting you; it is you, a reflection of your mind on a screen. - *[[1:57:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=7026s)]* **The devil in The Devil's Advocate: I have been watching, but I am no puppeteer; free will; I only set the stage, you pull your own strings.** — The devil does not make you do anything. He watches, seeking who gives him access to their senses, and sets the stage; America is his stage. You choose which script you act. - *[[2:09:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=7785s)]* **Nefarious: a demon explaining that it makes Edward do things he does not want to do, that demons have knowledge rather than beliefs, and that possession cannot just happen; it needs a series of yeses.** — Spirits can only communicate through your thoughts and set the stage. A demon takes control of your mouth, eyes, and hands only when you agree with the thought and act on it. ## Scriptures Opened **[2 Peter 3:9-11](/bible/2-peter/3#v9)** *[[10:19](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=619s)]* > [9](/bible/2-peter/3#v9) The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance. > > [10](/bible/2-peter/3#v10) But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up. > > [11](/bible/2-peter/3#v11) Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness, - We woke to the news of America and Israel, the iron fist and the hammer of the earth, attacking Iran. The bishops and deacons bring out the prophecies to show the time so we can self-assess and align our spirits, prepared as a bride adorned for the bridegroom. - The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, but is longsuffering to usward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance. He knows what he made and the internal and external struggles in the sinful cycle around us; he did not make you fall away. The day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, maybe tomorrow, maybe fifteen years, designed to keep us in the fear of the Lord all the day long as a lifestyle, not a temporary fear when the news breaks. - The heavens, the kingdoms, shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements, the periodic table, shall melt with fervent heat: only ICBMs, nuclear missiles, Satan II, and Poseidon have that power, and the Lord had them created to bring destruction on America, Israel, and every nation that put its hand to our people. The earth and the works therein shall be burned up, while brothers still sling and club and sisters twerk on cop cars. Seeing all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness? - We cannot control the politics, the media, or the world leaders, and cannot predict Israel's or Iran's next move. The one thing the Lord gave us control over is our mind and our vessel. We have to level up to self-control, mastery, and perfection, because the time is at hand. **[Genesis 1:28-29](/bible/genesis/1#v28)** *[[15:38](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=938s)]* > [28](/bible/genesis/1#v28) And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth. > > [29](/bible/genesis/1#v29) And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat. - Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth: the first order given was marriage and procreation. The very next verse: I have given you every herb bearing seed and every tree yielding fruit, to you it shall be for meat. Verse 28 is sex and verse 29 is food; one procreates life and the other nourishes the life that was procreated. - Neither is evil in itself. You need food to survive and sex to sustain life. It is the overindulgence of the two that becomes evil, when you lose self-control over either. **[Luke 21:34](/bible/luke/21#v34)** *[[17:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=1044s)]* > [34](/bible/luke/21#v34) And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares. - Take heed to yourselves, a self-examination, lest at any time your hearts, your minds, be overcharged with surfeiting. Christ always deals with the mind; that is what Satan attacked in the wilderness. Overcharged means over the limit: a gas tank, washer fluid, and engine oil each have a line, and go past it and things break down. The body is the vehicle God placed our spirit and soul in, with instructions and a limit. - And drunkenness: drink in moderation, because past a blood alcohol level you activate demons, tapping into the spiritual realm and giving Satan access to your vessel. That is why it is called wine and spirits. Even the gym can be excessive; everything in moderation, or spirits attach. And cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares. **[Philippians 3:18-19](/bible/philippians/3#v18)** *[[21:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=1286s)]* > [18](/bible/philippians/3#v18) (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ: > > [19](/bible/philippians/3#v19) Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.) - Many walk, of whom I tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ, whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly. The scribes and Pharisees could not resist the wisdom of Christ or deny his miracles, but they loved the position Rome placed them in, the greetings in the marketplace, and what comes with authority: food and sex. They crept into women's houses as in Susanna, and Eli's sons exploited the women at the temple, because position and status bring money, power, and respect. - Whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things: when am I going to eat, the things pleasing to the eyes and the flesh. Overindulging outside God's guidelines takes you out of the realm of discipline into the realm of Satan. Precepts: - **[Wisdom of Solomon 1:5](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/1#v5)** > [5](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/1#v5) For the holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit, and remove from thoughts that are without understanding, and will not abide when unrighteousness cometh in. The holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit, and remove from thoughts that are without understanding. Discipline is a holy spirit with a cap and a limit; the man who cannot stop eating worships himself. You cannot obtain discipline without the Holy Spirit, and there are levels to it, up to the disciples working miracles. Full access comes through disciplining the food intake and the sex outtake, the two stumbling blocks that keep us from progressing. - **[Sirach 33:29](/bible/sirach/33#v29)** > [29](/bible/sirach/33#v29) But be not excessive toward any; and without discretion do nothing. Be not excessive toward any, and without discretion do nothing. Ask why you are eating: nourishment, or because it looks, smells, tastes, and sounds good five minutes after you ate? A nymphomaniac wants sex all the time, but sex was created for procreation and beyond that becomes pleasure, and there is no level of pleasure at which the flesh is finally fulfilled. What high are you looking for when you smoke weed, since you always come down? There is only fulfillment in disciplining your spirit and keeping the commandments. - **[Romans 16:18](/bible/romans/16#v18)** > [18](/bible/romans/16#v18) For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple. They that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly. Biggie said he only sold crack to feed his family; his stomach became his god. Your vessel is an indicator of who you serve: your look, conduct, speech, and character tell who your god is. If you are grotesquely overweight, outside a natural diet, you are your own god, the same self-worship as a birthday. The good news is you can control it. **[1 Corinthians 6:12-13](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v12)** *[[32:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=1954s)]* > [12](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v12) All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of any. > > [13](/bible/1-corinthians/6#v13) Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats: but God shall destroy both it and them. Now the body is not for fornication, but for the Lord; and the Lord for the body. - All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient. Paul was speaking of meats offered to idols: lawful if within Leviticus 11 and Deuteronomy 14, but not profitable if it offends a brother without that knowledge, and I will not be brought under the power of any. - Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats, but God shall destroy both it and them: you are arguing over food that God will destroy along with the one consuming it. Now the body is not for fornication, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body. He moves from food to fornication, the man with his father's wife from the previous chapter, because both are self-control over your vessel, created to be used for the master's work. Precepts: - **[Sirach 18:30-31](/bible/sirach/18#v30)** > [30](/bible/sirach/18#v30) Go not after thy lusts, but refrain thyself from thine appetites. > > [31](/bible/sirach/18#v31) If thou givest thy soul the desires that please her, she will make thee a laughingstock to thine enemies that malign thee. Go not after thy lusts, but refrain thyself from thine appetites. Your appetite can be food, sex, the gym, TV, sports, or scrolling, whatever you overindulge in; today it is food and sex because if you get control over those two you can control anything. There are wants and needs: you need sex in marriage and food when hungry, then you choose what nourishes and gives energy to be productive. If thou givest thy soul the desires that please her, she will make thee a laughingstock. They post videos saying they cannot listen to a fat prophet, a brother bad to the bone in the street who cannot listen to himself, bring back fat-shaming. Satan tells you that you are hungry and to eat that McDonald's and that candy so you are sick every Sabbath and cannot do the work. Feed the body vitamins, fiber, and nutrients to possess the vessel. - **[1 John 2:15-16](/bible/1-john/2#v15)** > [15](/bible/1-john/2#v15) Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him. > > [16](/bible/1-john/2#v16) For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world. Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world; if any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him. America is the kingdom of sin, specifically designed against us to cater to and test the flesh, to forge you or destroy you; only the spiritually, mentally, and physically strong survive it. Scrolling is idle, porn, Instagram models, and clubbing are love of the world. All that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father; Satan was given power over this world to get you operating outside your purpose. **[Sirach 21:2](/bible/sirach/21#v2)** *[[1:14:31](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=4471s)]* > [2](/bible/sirach/21#v2) Flee from sin as from the face of a serpent: for if thou comest too near it, it will bite thee: the teeth thereof are as the teeth of a lion, slaying the souls of men. - Flee from sin as from the face of a serpent, for if thou comest too near it, it will bite thee. The preacher said you cannot flee what is in your refrigerator; the scripture uses the same word for sin. Flee the unhealthy foods, or they bite: brothers with health problems in the hospital every week who cannot make the Sabbath. You need a healthy vessel to do the work. - Working out is maybe ten or twenty percent, bodily exercise profiteth little; eighty percent of losing weight is the diet, and that is where the discipline is. Eating one meal a day did not work until the type of food changed, because preservatives and chemicals cannot break down. There is no such thing as the itis; the food makes you sleepy, and after a big meal in Japan we felt more awake and alert, which is what food is supposed to do. Categorizing calories, protein, fats, and fiber within a window became cross-discipline that carried into study habits, lust, and dealing with people. - The Lord is using Captain Shem's initiative with the yellow and red brothers for your health, because we need brothers fit and in the street to teach. Knowing it is not good for you and still indulging shows you lack discipline; a man who cannot control his own thoughts accomplishes nothing. Precepts: - **[Sirach 37:27-31](/bible/sirach/37#v27)** > [27](/bible/sirach/37#v27) My son, prove thy soul in thy life, and see what is evil for it, and give not that unto it. > > [28](/bible/sirach/37#v28) For all things are not profitable for all men, neither hath every soul pleasure in every thing. > > [29](/bible/sirach/37#v29) Be not unsatiable in any dainty thing, nor too greedy upon meats: > > [30](/bible/sirach/37#v30) For excess of meats bringeth sickness, and surfeiting will turn into choler. > > [31](/bible/sirach/37#v31) By surfeiting have many perished; but he that taketh heed prolongeth his life. My son, prove thy soul and thy life, and see what is evil for it, and give not that unto it; for all things are not profitable for all men, neither hath every soul pleasure in every thing. Be not unsatiable in any dainty thing, nor too greedy upon meats, for excess of meats bringeth sickness, and surfeiting will turn into choler. It is literally about food, and spiritually about proving your spirit: see what is evil for you and give it not, whether a food or a show like Spartacus full of sex scenes. A fat brother's diet is different from a slim officer's. **[1 Peter 2:11](/bible/1-peter/2#v11)** *[[1:21:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=4906s)]* > [11](/bible/1-peter/2#v11) Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul; - Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul. Food and sex are the two biggest fleshly lusts in the world, from Genesis 1. I did not know how serious it was until I walked past a cookie with a hundred calories left and the cookie was 240, and it was a battle: why am I struggling internally now that I withdraw from certain foods? The same happened fasting on a Sabbath in New York when the basket came, and I ate the chips. - I realized I actually have a lust for food: the jelly donut at Dunkin', the Doritos, thoughts replaying something you desire but are not supposed to have, until you justify one cookie and give in. That is no different from pornography, adultery, or fornication. And it is a big deal, because if you are not in the green you cannot go on the street; the Lord is putting a cap on us to show it is the exact same battle, a worldly lust inherited through America. Precepts: - **[1 Corinthians 9:27](/bible/1-corinthians/9#v27)** > [27](/bible/1-corinthians/9#v27) But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway. I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection, lest when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway. You can control your sexual appetite by controlling your food intake: abstain from the foods you desire and are tempted with. Alcohol is stored in your brain with late nights and social gatherings, so refuse to drink in that environment and you tell your reward vectors who is in charge. Abstain from the candy you love, and you gain power over the things with more control over you. Then disconnect the feelings associated with pornography, Instagram, and looking, rewire the neurons, and fire them into a new habit, open a Bible instead, so the brain associates that environment with the new function. **[Matthew 15:16-18](/bible/matthew/15#v16)** *[[1:45:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=6306s)]* > [16](/bible/matthew/15#v16) And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding? > > [17](/bible/matthew/15#v17) Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught? > > [18](/bible/matthew/15#v18) But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man. - Are ye also yet without understanding? Whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly and is cast out into the draught; but those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart, and they defile the man. The Pharisees were arguing about eating with unwashed hands. What comes out of your mouth is the output value of what was input into your mind. - The brain stores everything: a random song from years ago surfaces because it is saved in long-term memory, the way your stuff never really leaves the internet. What you put into your vessel determines what comes out, and often we do not realize we are being controlled; you were made in a factory called America and those are not your words. The only way to break the code is to reprogram and recode. Precepts: - **[Sirach 31:13](/bible/sirach/31#v13)** > [13](/bible/sirach/31#v13) Remember that a wicked eye is an evil thing: and what is created more wicked than an eye? therefore it weepeth upon every occasion. Remember that a wicked eye is an evil thing, and what is created more wicked than an eye? Therefore it weepeth upon every occasion. It starts with the desire of what you see, then the mind decides whether to feed the lust. - **[Job 31:1](/bible/job/31#v1)** > [1](/bible/job/31#v1) I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid? I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid? Job had to make a covenant: if it comes into my eyesight, I turn away. Netflix keeps it moving to hold your eyes, because the eyes are the portal to the vessel. Psalms 101:3: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes. Train your eyes to click past the enticing scene, and leave the conversation when the gossip starts, because three seconds of it will taint you. **[1 Peter 5:8](/bible/1-peter/5#v8)** *[[1:59:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=7148s)]* > [8](/bible/1-peter/5#v8) Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour: - Be sober, be vigilant, because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour. He watches for the simple, for who gives him their eyes, ears, and taste, access to the senses to manipulate. He makes nobody do anything; he sets the stage and you pull your own strings. Some of you are just wicked, with the wrong script. - There are spirits in an unseen realm communicating through your mind, telling you what to think. You cannot stop the thoughts, but whether you take hold of them is your decision: agree and act, or disagree and go another way. Precepts: - **[Job 1:10-12](/bible/job/1#v10)** > [10](/bible/job/1#v10) Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land. > > [11](/bible/job/1#v11) But put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face. > > [12](/bible/job/1#v12) And the Lord said unto Satan, Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of the Lord. Hast not thou made an hedge about him? Put forth thine hand and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face. All that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand. Satan can take your possessions and manipulate your environment, but not your actions. Job 2:7-9: he smote Job with boils and then his wife said, curse God, and die. Satan did not control her; he put the thought in the weaker vessel, since women give in to their emotions more than men, and she chose to act on it. - **[John 13:2](/bible/john/13#v2)** > [2](/bible/john/13#v2) And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him; The devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot to betray him. He put the thought in Judas's heart and Judas acted on it. - **[Matthew 16:22-23](/bible/matthew/16#v22)** > [22](/bible/matthew/16#v22) Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee. > > [23](/bible/matthew/16#v23) But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men. Peter rebuked him, be it far from thee, Lord, and Christ said, get thee behind me, Satan, thou savourest not the things that be of God. Peter had good intentions, but even when good is present evil is there, and Christ spotted Satan from a distance without Peter knowing. Measure your intentions and words through the word of God, because Satan can whisper through your thoughts if your mind is not in tune with the scriptures. - **[Wisdom of Solomon 6:16](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/6#v16)** > [16](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/6#v16) For she goeth about seeking such as are worthy of her, sheweth herself favourably unto them in the ways, and meeteth them in every thought. She goeth about seeking such as are worthy of her, and meeteth them in every thought. Wisdom has to meet you in every thought: what is the outcome of this thought? In an argument with your husband, the thought says say this word and you can trigger him; filter it for godly intentions. 2 Corinthians 13:10: the power the Lord gave is to edification, and not to destruction. Someone's positive word may land negative because Satan knows what you are going through and uses their vessel; you choose to respond for edification or to bring contention, or to wink at ignorance. Everything is a choice. - **[Genesis 4:7](/bible/genesis/4#v7)** > [7](/bible/genesis/4#v7) If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him. If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. Doing well is a covenant with God's commandments: I will not watch, eat, touch, or taste that. Doing not well is a covenant with death, Satan's commandments; every disagreement with God's commandment is an agreement with Satan's. Agree to go past the alcohol limit and you let a spirit take your body; agree with the thought that you do not like that sister and you spread gossip through the body; agree with the hunger pains and the smell and a gluttony spirit is on you. A contract with the thought lets the demon tunnel through the five senses to full possession. **[Galatians 5:16-17](/bible/galatians/5#v16)** *[[2:13:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=8025s)]* > [16](/bible/galatians/5#v16) This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh. > > [17](/bible/galatians/5#v17) For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would. - Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh. With a strong unit of brothers keeping each other in check, studying, and sitting at the doorsteps of the bishops and deacons, addicted to God's word, you have no time to entertain the flesh: no four hours of Netflix, no music that taints your thought process. Some of you from the streets have not changed because the music you listen to has not brought change, and you lust because you always watch what makes you lust. - Reprogram your mindset, refire and rewire the brain into godly habits, and control what you hear, see, taste, and smell. For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh. **[John 4:31-34](/bible/john/4#v31)** *[[2:15:11](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=8111s)]* > [31](/bible/john/4#v31) In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat. > > [32](/bible/john/4#v32) But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of. > > [33](/bible/john/4#v33) Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat? > > [34](/bible/john/4#v34) Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work. - The disciples said, Master, eat; but he said, I have meat to eat that ye know not of. They tried to tell Christ what to do, and he showed complete control of his vessel, his mission, and his goals. Nobody programmed Christ but the Father from the beginning; he was the master of his own sight, smell, taste, hearing, and thoughts, the programmer of his own operating system. - My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work. Not fleshly nourishment; he did not even take a wife, because he resisted the things you need for life and to nourish life. That is my existence, my food, my vessel, my senses, my programmer, and the reason I was born, so that no one else controls me. ## Class Questions - **What is the one thing we control while America and Israel war with Iran?** Our own vessel and mind. We cannot control the politics, media, or world leaders, but 2 Peter 3:11 asks what manner of persons we ought to be seeing all these things shall be dissolved. - **What do Genesis 1:28 and 1:29 have to do with each other?** Verse 28 is sex, be fruitful and multiply, and verse 29 is food, every herb and fruit for meat. One procreates life and the other nourishes it. Neither is evil; the overindulgence is. - **What does surfeiting mean in Luke 21:34?** Excess, going over the limit of the vessel like overfilling a gas tank. Overcharged hearts, drunkenness, and the cares of this life make that day come unawares. - **Whose God is their belly?** The enemies of the cross of Christ, Philippians 3:19, the Pharisees who loved position for the food and sex it brought, and those who serve their own belly, Romans 16:18. Your vessel indicates who you serve. - **Why is discipline called a holy spirit?** Wisdom of Solomon 1:5. Discipline has a cap and a limit and must be practiced; full access to the Holy Spirit comes through disciplining food intake and sex outtake. - **Why can there be no fulfillment in excess?** Sex beyond procreation is pleasure and the flesh never reaches a level of fulfillment, just as every high comes down. Be not excessive toward any, Sirach 33:29; only disciplining the spirit fulfils. - **How does Paul connect food and fornication in 1 Corinthians 6:12-13?** Meats for the belly and the belly for meats, but the body is not for fornication but for the Lord. Both are self-control over a vessel made for the master's work. - **What makes a man a laughingstock in Sirach 18:31?** Giving his soul the desires that please her: the fat prophet nobody will listen to because he does not listen to himself. Refrain from your appetites, whatever they are. - **Why does the class call food porn the same as pornography?** The brain fires the same dopamine reward vectors for greasy food as for sex and does not distinguish them. Flee from sin as from a serpent, Sirach 21:2, includes fleeing the refrigerator. - **How do you bring the body into subjection, 1 Corinthians 9:27?** Abstain from the foods and drinks you love, especially in the environments your brain associates them with, then disconnect the feelings linked to pornography and scrolling and rewire them to a new habit like opening a Bible. - **What is the three-second rule?** Turn away from a triggering sight or thought within three seconds, before it enters working memory and then long-term memory. Job made a covenant with his eyes, Job 31:1; set no wicked thing before your eyes, Psalms 101:3. - **How does Satan operate according to Job 1 and 2?** He watches, sets the stage, and manipulates your environment and possessions, but cannot touch your actions. He put the thought in Job's wife and in Judas, John 13:2, and spoke through Peter, Matthew 16:23; the choice to act is yours. - **What is a series of yeses?** The agreements with tempting thoughts that let a demon take possession. Genesis 4:7: do well and be accepted, a covenant with God's commandments; do not well and sin lieth at the door, a covenant with Satan's. - **What was Christ's meat?** To do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work, John 4:34. He was master of his own senses and programmer of his own vessel. ## In Closing *[[2:15:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSghv3QbJAo&t=8159s)]* My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work. Christ was in complete control of his own vessel, his own senses, and his own thoughts, the programmer of his own operating system, and nobody could influence him but the Father who programmed him from the beginning. That should be all of our agendas: to eat the will of the Father, to consume the scriptures, to see them, taste them, hear them, and believe them. Brothers, this is our meat, this is our nourishment, this is our life.
